schema.text: How does the level of 'liveliness' (the presence of other people, shops, and activity) on your route affect your journey?

options.text: Very positively, lively environments make me feel safer or more comfortable
Somewhat positively, lively environments improve my travel experience
Neutral, the level of activity does not affect my journey
Somewhat negatively, quiet or empty areas can make me feel uncomfortable
Very negatively, overly busy or crowded areas make the journey stressful or difficult to navigate

en.#How does the level of 'liveliness' (the: How does the level of 'liveliness' (the presence of other people, shops, and activity) on your route affect your journey?
en.#Very positively, lively environments ma: Very positively, lively environments make me feel safer or more comfortable
en.#Somewhat positively, lively environment: Somewhat positively, lively environments improve my travel experience
en.#Neutral, the level of activity does not: Neutral, the level of activity does not affect my journey
en.#Somewhat negatively, quiet or empty are: Somewhat negatively, quiet or empty areas can make me feel uncomfortable
en.#Very negatively, overly busy or crowded: Very negatively, overly busy or crowded areas make the journey stressful or difficult to navigate

it.#How does the level of 'liveliness' (the: In che modo il livello di «vivacità» del percorso, cioè la presenza di altre persone, negozi e attività, influisce sul tuo spostamento?
it.#Very positively, lively environments ma: Molto positivamente: gli ambienti vivaci mi fanno sentire più sicuro/a o a mio agio
it.#Somewhat positively, lively environment: Abbastanza positivamente: gli ambienti vivaci migliorano la mia esperienza di viaggio
it.#Neutral, the level of activity does not: In modo neutro: il livello di attività non influisce sul mio spostamento
it.#Somewhat negatively, quiet or empty are: Abbastanza negativamente: le zone tranquille o deserte possono farmi sentire a disagio
it.#Very negatively, overly busy or crowded: Molto negativamente: le zone eccessivamente trafficate o affollate rendono lo spostamento stressante o difficile da affrontare

fr.#How does the level of 'liveliness' (the: Comment le niveau d’animation de votre itinéraire, c’est-à-dire la présence d’autres personnes, de commerces et d’activités, influence-t-il votre trajet ?
fr.#Very positively, lively environments ma: Très positivement : les endroits animés me font sentir plus en sécurité ou plus à l’aise
fr.#Somewhat positively, lively environment: Plutôt positivement : les endroits animés améliorent mon expérience de déplacement
fr.#Neutral, the level of activity does not: De façon neutre : le niveau d’activité n’influence pas mon trajet
fr.#Somewhat negatively, quiet or empty are: Plutôt négativement : les endroits calmes ou vides peuvent me mettre mal à l’aise
fr.#Very negatively, overly busy or crowded: Très négativement : les endroits trop fréquentés ou bondés rendent le trajet stressant ou difficile

de.#How does the level of 'liveliness' (the: Wie beeinflusst die Belebtheit Ihrer Strecke, also die Anwesenheit anderer Menschen, Geschäfte und Aktivitäten, Ihren Weg?
de.#Very positively, lively environments ma: Sehr positiv: Belebte Orte geben mir mehr Sicherheit oder Komfort
de.#Somewhat positively, lively environment: Eher positiv: Belebte Orte verbessern mein Erlebnis unterwegs
de.#Neutral, the level of activity does not: Neutral: Die Belebtheit beeinflusst meinen Weg nicht
de.#Somewhat negatively, quiet or empty are: Eher negativ: Ruhige oder leere Bereiche können dazu führen, dass ich mich unwohl fühle
de.#Very negatively, overly busy or crowded: Sehr negativ: Sehr belebte oder überfüllte Bereiche machen den Weg stressig oder schwer überschaubar

tr.#How does the level of 'liveliness' (the: Güzergâhınızdaki canlılık düzeyi, yani başka insanların, dükkânların ve etkinliklerin varlığı, yolculuğunuzu nasıl etkiler?
tr.#Very positively, lively environments ma: Çok olumlu: canlı yerler kendimi daha güvende veya rahat hissettirir
tr.#Somewhat positively, lively environment: Biraz olumlu: canlı yerler yolculuk deneyimimi iyileştirir
tr.#Somewhat negatively, quiet or empty are: Biraz olumsuz: sessiz veya boş alanlar beni rahatsız edebilir
tr.#Very negatively, overly busy or crowded: Çok olumsuz: aşırı yoğun veya kalabalık alanlar yolculuğu stresli veya yön bulmayı zor hale getirir

fa.#How does the level of 'liveliness' (the: میزان «زندگی و فعالیت» در مسیر شما، یعنی حضور افراد، فروشگاه‌ها و فعالیت‌ها، چگونه بر سفرتان اثر می‌گذارد؟
fa.#Very positively, lively environments ma: بسیار مثبت؛ محیط‌های پررفت‌وآمد باعث می‌شوند احساس امنیت یا راحتی بیشتری کنم
fa.#Somewhat positively, lively environment: تا حدی مثبت؛ محیط‌های پررفت‌وآمد تجربه سفر مرا بهتر می‌کنند
fa.#Neutral, the level of activity does not: خنثی؛ میزان فعالیت اطراف بر سفرم اثری ندارد
fa.#Somewhat negatively, quiet or empty are: تا حدی منفی؛ مناطق آرام یا خالی ممکن است باعث ناراحتی من شوند
fa.#Very negatively, overly busy or crowded: بسیار منفی؛ مناطق بسیار شلوغ یا پرازدحام سفر را پراسترس یا جهت‌یابی را دشوار می‌کنند

hu.#How does the level of 'liveliness' (the: Hogyan befolyásolja az útvonal „élettelisége”, vagyis más emberek, üzletek és tevékenységek jelenléte az utazását?
hu.#Very positively, lively environments ma: Nagyon pozitívan: az élénk környezet biztonságosabbá vagy kényelmesebbé teszi számomra az utat
hu.#Somewhat positively, lively environment: Inkább pozitívan: az élénk környezet javítja az utazási élményemet
hu.#Neutral, the level of activity does not: Semlegesen: a környezet aktivitása nem befolyásolja az utazásomat
hu.#Somewhat negatively, quiet or empty are: Inkább negatívan: a csendes vagy üres területek kényelmetlen érzést kelthetnek
hu.#Very negatively, overly busy or crowded: Nagyon negatívan: a túl forgalmas vagy zsúfolt területek stresszessé vagy nehezen áttekinthetővé teszik az utat

ar.#How does the level of 'liveliness' (the: كيف يؤثر مستوى النشاط والحيوية على طريقك، أي وجود أشخاص ومتاجر وأنشطة، في رحلتك؟
ar.#Very positively, lively environments ma: بشكل إيجابي جدًا: الأماكن الحيوية تجعلني أشعر بأمان أو راحة أكبر
ar.#Somewhat positively, lively environment: بشكل إيجابي إلى حد ما: الأماكن الحيوية تحسن تجربة التنقل
ar.#Neutral, the level of activity does not: بشكل محايد: مستوى النشاط لا يؤثر في رحلتي
ar.#Somewhat negatively, quiet or empty are: بشكل سلبي إلى حد ما: الأماكن الهادئة أو الخالية قد تجعلني غير مرتاح
ar.#Very negatively, overly busy or crowded: بشكل سلبي جدًا: الأماكن شديدة الازدحام تجعل الرحلة مرهقة أو تجعل معرفة الطريق أصعب
